text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival.
It is an event to entertain the fans who support the Umamusume day in and day out.
The main highlights of the Spring Thanksgiving include sports-style competitions and events—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the hype is crazy~☆
Hey, hey, next up is the Dirt 2000m race~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, you're competing in this event too!Come on, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! No way, no way!
Maya's on a date with Trainer-chan right now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Waaah, even you, Trainer-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... Hishiama-san,
that's so mean! Our date was supposed to be so special...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Sure, it's a festival today,
but don't get too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Forgotten already? Look around you more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And you realize.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...My surroundings...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Quiet. I'll show you what I've got.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... it fits nicely.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, everyone's looking at Falco☆
Eeeep, I'm gonna keep all your eyes on me like this~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...How is it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Maya might not have really
ever raced against them before."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. It's quite an unusual lineup
for you to be facing."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's true this race isn't the main event.
And that's precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You can even go toe-to-toe in a one-on-one match against opponents you'd normally never face off against.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No matter the race, that exact lineup of competitors
will only ever come together once in a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why you should give each and every time your all...
and enjoy it even more.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I'll just enjoy it recklessly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yep. So you're gonna grow even more through this race too!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Growth?! An adult?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Eye copy☆ Today, I'm gonna cross the finish line way ahead of Hishi Ama-san too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey!? Aren't you getting
a little too carried away with that!?
And the 2,000m dirt race got underwayâ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ugggh... Traineeer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Mayano!
You got completely wiped out, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's a good opportunity.
Take a good look at the winner's face and use that frustration as fuel."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That's how I got stronger, too.
...Heh-heh."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Gugugu... It's to get stronger... To grow bigger...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyooone~~! Thank you so much~~â

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!! Falcooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~, no, no, no!
So frustrating, frustrating, frustrating~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wanted to bathe in
Trainer-chan's cheers out there too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... You really don't ever shut up
about your Trainer, do you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Because I wanted Trainer-chan
to see a grown-up Maya.
choice_data_list: Still, I could clearly see how much you've grown.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I knew it, I'm gonna run one more time!
I'm definitely winning next time, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I told you, you can only run it once!
...Geez!"

And together with Hishi Amazon,
we managed to restrain the rampaging Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chaaaan!!
Maya won 1st placeーー☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Praise me more, more!☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...She's a terrifying kid.
To think she'd beat not just me,
but that whole lineup...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi. Hishi Ama-san, thanks a bunch
for letting Maya run in this race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya had so much fun!
It was super... thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about what can only be done in this race,
and coming up with all sorts of strategies."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Maya tried out all the running styles
that seemed the most exciting in this race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...! You mean to say you came up with all of that on the spot?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Seriously, that kid has terrifying potential...!

It turned out to be a day that drove home the fact
that Mayano Top Gun was steadily growing stronger.
